description: Read one page of a seen list: which identities this account already recorded, their state (seen or claimed) and when they were added. A claimed entry whose claim_expires_at is in the past has been released and is searchable again. not_found means this brief has no list yet. Use it to resume an interrupted run. Costs 0 credits.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's next_cursor.

name: get_seen_list
title: Read a seen list
